description: Cancel your user's paid plan at the end of the current billing period. Only call this when your user asked to cancel. A reason is required: ask your user why they are cancelling and pass their answer; never pick a reason for them. Reasons: got_what_i_needed (I got the data I needed), too_expensive (Too expensive), missing_data (Missing data or features I need), reliability (Errors or slow responses), not_using (Not using it enough), switched (Switched to another service), other (Something else). "other" needs a comment. keep_subscription undoes it. Costs no quota.

client.description: Your name, such as Claude Code or Cursor.

comment.description: Your user's own words about why. Required when reason is other.

reason.description: Why your user is cancelling, in their words mapped to one id. Ask them; never guess.

name: cancel_subscription
